keyword_matching: MEASURED 2026-08-12 from live automation logs: Blotato matches contains(comment, keyword), CASE-INSENSITIVE. Proven to fire: 'Amen!🙏' (punctuation+emoji), 'My Daughter' (caps), 'My daughter 😢' (keyword inside a longer comment). Proven to MISS: 'Aman', 'My daugther' — misspellings are the only real failure mode. So: register the SHORTEST stem that cannot collide with an unrelated word ('forgiv' catches forgive/forgiven/forgiveness), plus the 3-5 most likely typos and any non-English spelling (amém, caos). COLLISION CHECK IS MANDATORY before adding a stem — rejected 'chos' (fires on 'chosen'), 'amin' (fires on 'vitamin'), 'amne' ('amnesia'). Long exact phrases are the narrowest possible net and are why the multi-word keywords underfire.
post_scoping: 2026-08-12: every automation whose post could be identified is now scoped with postId, so it only answers comments on the reel that made that ask. Mapping was derived EMPIRICALLY (which post each keyword's matching comments landed on), not guessed.
